clauses.title: No-PO invoices
clauses.text: Invoices without a purchase order may be paid up to ₹1,00,000 with a retro PO raised within 3 working days.

clauses.title: Splitting
clauses.text: Splitting one requirement into several invoices or POs to stay under a limit is prohibited; invoices from the same supplier for the same work within 60 days are aggregated.

clauses.title: Bank changes
clauses.text: Any change to supplier bank details must be confirmed by a phone call to the number on the supplier master before the next payment.

clauses.title: MSME suppliers
clauses.text: MSME-registered suppliers are paid within 45 days of acceptance (MSMED Act s.15; Income-tax Act s.43B(h)).

clauses.title: Year-end spend
clauses.text: Spend in the last month of the financial year above budget needs a business case showing use in the next quarter.
